_doc: IVF coarse-quantizer + cell probing. Toy = 9 points, nlist=3 frozen centroids, query q in cell c0 (stdlib). True 3-NN = 2 points in c0 + 1 just across the border in c1. nprobe=1 probes c0 only → 2/3 → recall@3 = 0.6667; nprobe=2 also probes c1 (the 2nd-nearest cell) → 3/3 → 1.0. COMMITTED GEOMETRY is asserted here and in provenance_l9: exactly 2 NN in c0, the 3rd in c1, AND c1 is the 2nd-nearest cell to q (cellRankByDist[1]==c1) — else nprobe=2 would not reach the 3rd NN and recall would not climb 0.6667→1.0. Real = frozen FAISS IVF-PQ recall vs nprobe (gen_l9_real.py).
